_comment: Consistency set (docs/SETTINGS_AUDIT.md, src/core/consistency.c): one value for every player. Each entry names a CVAR_LOCKED cvar; it is applied at startup (release builds reject any other write; CVAR_RULE ones may be changed by the host's server rules for a session, replicated, never by a client). The hash of this set (sorted name=value pairs) is part of the lobby build hash and of MSG_HELLO: a client with another set cannot join. Engine Fidelity levels never touch these: they trade cost for quality, not visibility.

r_foliage_density.why: Grass and plant density hides prone players: the same for everyone (Low used to draw a tenth). Lobby rule: 0.5 .. 1 for the whole session.

r_vgeo_impostor_px.why: Size at which small cover (grass tufts, bushes) turns into impostor cards (classic renderer): the same switch for everyone.

r_classic_impostor_px.why: Size at which trees turn into impostor cards (classic renderer, was 64 vs 16 for vgeo).

r_vgeo_lod_px.why: Classic discrete LOD pick (levels scaled it x1 .. x8, eras 2 .. 12 px).

r_lod_bias.why: Character LOD bias (levels 0.25 .. 1): distant players keep the same detail for everyone.

r_char_quality.why: Character quality only scaled the character LOD switch points (0.5 .. 1.25x): fixed at x1.

r_shadow_max_distance.why: Sun shadow distance (levels 50 .. 300 m): enemy shadows reach as far for everyone; levels keep resolution and cascades.

r_cloud_shadows.why: Cloud shadows darken patches of the map (Off / Low dropped them).

r_light_shadows.why: Lamp / flashlight shadows: without them a lamp lit the players behind a wall (Off / Low dropped them).

r_light_shadow_count.why: Shadowed lamps per frame (MAX_SHADOW_POINTS): the same lamps cast shadows for everyone.

r_fog_scale.why: Fog density multiplier (was 0 .. 10 in the config): the weather sets the fog. Lobby rule only.

r_atmosphere.why: Aerial perspective: distant haze hides far targets equally.

r_auto_exposure.why: Auto exposure with the shared day / night EV clamps (night floor): no fixed bright exposure at night.

r_exposure.why: Exposure compensation (+-4 EV) lifted the night darkness floor.

r_gamma.why: Gamma 0.5 .. 2 lifted shadows; brightness keeps a narrow calibration band instead.

r_lut.why: A user grading LUT could flatten the darkness.

r_look.why: Every session starts on the Realism look (the other looks are dev presets).

r_era.why: Era preset: modern for everyone (no longer a setting).

r_tonemapper.why: The tonemapper belongs to the Look (AgX).

r_bloom_intensity.why: Bloom strength as the Look intends: glare near lamps, the sun and muzzle flashes is the same for everyone.

r_lens_flare.why: Lens flare ghosts near the sun / lamps (0 at every level).

r_lens_dirt.why: Lens dirt on bloom (0 at every level).

r_lens_distortion.why: Lens distortion changes target positions on screen.

r_lens_drops.why: Rain droplets on the camera: on for everyone (switching them off cleared the view in rain).

r_stretch.why: Stretched resolution made targets wider on screen.

vfx_decal_max.why: Impact decals (levels kept 16 .. 4096): blood and impacts stay as long for everyone.

vfx_max_particles.why: Particle pool: a small pool silently dropped smoke / impact particles.

fx_tracers.why: Bullet tracers: shooter positions show the same for everyone.

bal_vapor_trails.why: Vapour trails behind bullets in humid / freezing air.

world_chunk_radius.why: Draw distance (chunks around the player). Lobby rule only.

world_lod_distance.why: First terrain LOD switch (m). Lobby rule only.

cl_ads_world_zoom.why: ADS world zoom comes from the sight data, not a setting.

crosshair_obstruct.why: The crosshair shows where the bullet lands when the muzzle is blocked (docs/AIM.md).

crosshair_follow_kick.why: The crosshair shows the true aim point.

cl_interp.why: Entity interpolation delay (ms): the same view delay of remote players for everyone.

cl_predict_impacts.why: Own impacts shown at once (predicted) for everyone.

cl_predict_hit_reactions.why: Unconfirmed hit reactions shown the same for everyone.

cl_healthbars.why: Health bars over characters show game state. Lobby rule.

dev_damage_numbers.why: Damage numbers show game state. Lobby rule.

anim_lean.why: Remote players lean the same for everyone (off hid a peeking head).

anim_ragdoll_time.why: Corpses stay 45 s for everyone (cover, DNA).

peek_fov.why: Door peek field of view through the visor.

r_terrain.why: Terrain shading on (the old layer blend changes ground contrast).

r_surfaces.why: Surface textures on (vertex colours change contrast).
